title: cardamine flexuosa subsp. pensylvanica
intro: Cardamine flexuosa subsp. pensylvanica, commonly known as Pennsylvania bittercress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Cardamine flexuosa subsp. pensylvanica include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
